note: L'établi (s02maison zone; repaint_fixes re-layout 2026-10-22): close-up of the R_garage workshop (same whitewashed brick and concrete floor), garden doorway at the left. Re-laid out so every figure stands or kneels in its own spot on the floor (no row behind one workbench; the long bench is gone): girl in the doorway with a red kite (ficelle), woman at a post-mounted bench vice on a giant screw (vis), man cranking an engine on a stand (manivelle), grey-haired man clipping on a fake moustache (attache), pegboard of tools high on the back wall (outil), man on a crate clutching his toe with the hammer by his boot (marteau), detective at a tagged nail in a post (clou), woman sculptor with chisel and bust (ciseau), cat bouncing off a coil spring (ressort), Sam kneeling with go-kart parts (assemblage). No links (zone).
